badges.name: UNESCO Marker Passer
badges.description: You've reached the gateway of Mt. Hamiguitan. The UNESCO marker stands as a reminder that you now walk on world heritage ground — a feat reserved for those who dare to begin.

badges.name: River Crossing
badges.description: Across cool rushing waters and polished white stones, you've crossed the first true test of the trail. Not all trekkers make it this far.

badges.name: First Horizon
badges.description: From Lantawan 1, the horizon expands and the valley spreads wide below. The mountain has finally given you your first full view — and it's just the beginning.

badges.name: The Root Climber
badges.description: This ancient trail weaves through gnarled roots and narrow ridges. Only those who learned to read the mountain's floor can pass through the Uwang-Uwang path.

badges.name: Pygmy Settler
badges.description: Camp 3 is where the mountain offers rest before the ascent grows steeper. You've settled here for a moment — a small victory that fuels the climb ahead.

badges.name: Dwarf Guardian
badges.description: In the pygmy forest, ancient bonsai trees stand no taller than your knee — yet they've weathered centuries. To earn this badge is to understand that true strength needs no height.

badges.name: Serpentinite Soul
badges.description: Black Mountain's serpentinite soil filters out the ordinary and fosters only the extraordinary. By reaching this point, you've proven you belong here.

badges.name: Hydrological Finale
badges.description: Twin Falls marks where two streams reunite in a final flourish before silence reclaims the valley. You've witnessed one of Hamiguitan's most serene hidden rewards.

badges.name: Apex Overlook
badges.description: Standing at the peak of Mt. Hamiguitan, you've earned a view that very few humans have ever witnessed. This is what legends are made of.

badges.name: The Lost Ocean
badges.description: Tinagong Dagat — the hidden sea — reveals itself only to those who push beyond the ordinary path. You've found the unfindable. The mountain kept this secret just for you.

badges.name: Mist Walker
badges.description: Where the clouds settle between the treetops and every stone wears a coat of velvet moss, you walked through Hamiguitan's most mystical corridor.

badges.name: Botanist's Veil
badges.description: The endemic pitcher plants, carnivorous mosses, and rare orchids of Hamiguitan exist nowhere else on Earth. Photograph and document three unique endemic species to earn this badge.

requirement.value: Photograph and document 3 unique endemic plant species found on the trail.

badges.name: Leave No Trace Master
badges.description: A true guardian of the mountain. Complete a full trek demonstrating Leave No Trace principles — submit photographic evidence of your clean campsite, proper waste disposal, and trail etiquette.

requirement.value: Submit evidence of LNT compliance: clean campsite, proper waste disposal, and trail etiquette across a full trek.

badges.name: Pitcher Perfection
badges.description: Mt. Hamiguitan is home to three endemic Nepenthes pitcher plant species found nowhere else in the world. Photograph and correctly identify all three to earn this elite badge.

requirement.value: Photograph all 3 endemic Nepenthes pitcher plant species (N. micromphora, N. hamiguitanensis, N. peltata) with clear identification.

badges.name: Shadow of the King
badges.description: The Philippine Eagle soars above Hamiguitan's canopy as the undisputed king of the skies. Capture a verifiable photograph of this critically endangered raptor to earn the mountain's most prestigious badge.

requirement.value: Capture a verifiable in-habitat photograph of the Philippine Eagle (Pithecophaga jefferyi) during your trek.

categories.name: Trail Completion
categories.description: Badges earned through courage, exploration, and progression along the Hamiguitan trail.

categories.name: Biodiversity & Nature
categories.description: Achievements gained through curiosity and learning about the wonders of Hamiguitan.

categories.name: Conservation & Stewardship
categories.description: Badges honoring those who trek thoughtfully and protect the trails they explore.
